elevation.$description: Elevation 100 to 800 from the Figma effect styles, and the focus rings.

focus.$description: Default focus ring: a surface gap and a 2 px ring, at least 3:1 on every surface.

focus-inset.$description: Inside the element, for full-width rows and tabs where an outer ring would be clipped.

focus-danger.$description: Focus on a field that has an error.

focus-inverse.$description: Focus on inverse (dark in light mode) surfaces.

focus-halo.$description: Soft halo from the Figma effect styles. Decorative: always combine with a focus ring.

space.$description: Layout spacing. 4 px grid, from the Figma spacing scale.

touch-target.$description: 44 px. Minimum hit area for anything interactive on touch screens.

control.$description: Default control radius (md). Size-specific radii live in control.radius.
The one control scale. Buttons, fields, selects and segmented controls of the same size share height, radius and padding, so they line up side by side.

input.$description: TextField, Select, AmountInput and OTPInput boxes.

breakpoint.$description: Reference only: CSS cannot read variables in media queries.

grid.$description: Column grid. Phones use 4 columns, tablets 8, desktops 12. Gutters and page margins come from the spacing scale.

type.$description: Type roles. Display and title roles are fluid between 360 and 1280 px viewports.
